name: How much does it cost to replace windows to fix drafts?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace windows to fix drafts?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window replacement to fix drafts varies based on several factors, including the type and material of the new windows, their size, the number of windows being replaced, and installation complexity. Premium energy-efficient windows will cost more upfront but offer long-term savings on energy bills. A professional estimate is essential to get an accurate cost for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies widely depending on window type, material, size, and installation complexity. Get a professional estimate for an accurate price.
